en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own family and compare Kuala Lumpur schools with the same care
en.runTitle: Moving to Kuala Lumpur with a 7- and an 11-year-old: which international school fits RM 110,000 a year?

fields.label: Children’s birth dates, year groups and English/Mandarin needs
fields.value: Ages 7 (Year 3) and 11 (Year 7); English-medium teaching with some Mandarin support

fields.label: Move and intended start dates
fields.value: Moving to Kuala Lumpur in July 2027; aiming for an August 2027 start

fields.label: Annual budget and upfront cash
fields.value: RM 110,000 a year for both children combined, all-in (tuition, application and registration, deposits spread over the years, capital levy, bus, uniforms)

fields.label: Both office locations and morning limit
fields.value: One parent works in Mont Kiara, the other at KL Sentral; morning commute under 40 minutes

fields.label: Itemised school offers and transport quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. a school’s written fee letter for both children and a bus quote of RM 600 a month each

en.template: Help our family compare Kuala Lumpur international schools using {kids}, {dates}, {budget}, {offices}, and {offers}. Keep both children and the intended physical campus together. Separate first-year cash, deposit allocation, future progression and unresolved costs; flag support, tax, refund, vacancy and commute gaps. Ask before contacting schools, submitting forms, sharing documents or paying anything.

phases.title: Collect official, dated fee and admissions pages for six schools
phases.note: Fees, entry steps, sibling rules and Mandarin provision, school by school
phases.judgment: It would not count Fairview’s fee page as current: the annual-fee section was still labelled 2023/24. Taylor’s fees are for calendar year 2027, not an August 2027 to July 2028 school year, and they are flagged that way.

phases.title: Build the cost model and write the guide, with every claim tied to a source
phases.judgment: The recommendation is Sayfol, but its RM96,879.20 a year is labelled “plus unresolved costs”, not an all-in quote. Sri Bestari is kept only as a conditional September fallback because it exceeds the first-year budget.

phases.title: Recompute the figures, check claims against sources and test desktop and phone layout
phases.judgment: A separate recalculation passed 122 checks. The open issues were written down rather than hidden: places for both children are unconfirmed, 2027/28 invoices are missing, and some pages were read through a browser that could not be shown to be fresh and signed-out.

workers: Read Sri Bestari International’s and Hibiscus’s fee schedules, admission steps and Mandarin provision
Read Taylor’s and Fairview’s fees, calendars and admission rules, and checked which fee year each one covers
Read HELP’s and Sri KDU’s 2026/27 fees, sibling priority, assessments and Mandarin options

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你们家的情况，用同样的细致程度比较吉隆坡的学校
zh.runTitle: 带 7 岁和 11 岁的孩子搬去吉隆坡：每年 11 万令吉能读哪所国际学校？

fields.label: 孩子的出生日期、年级及英语和中文需求
fields.value: 7 岁（Year 3）和 11 岁（Year 7）；英语授课，并有一定中文支持

fields.label: 搬家及计划开学日期
fields.value: 2027 年 7 月搬到吉隆坡；希望 2027 年 8 月入学

fields.label: 年度预算和入学前可用现金
fields.value: 两个孩子合计每年 11 万令吉，全包（学费、申请和注册费、分摊的押金、资本费、校车、校服）

fields.label: 两处办公地址及早晨路程上限
fields.value: 一位家长在 Mont Kiara 上班，另一位在 KL Sentral；早上路程不超过 40 分钟

fields.label: 逐项录取费用和交通报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：学校给两个孩子的书面收费通知，以及每人每月 600 令吉的校车报价

zh.template: 请根据{kids}、{dates}、{budget}、{offices}，以及{offers}，帮我们比较吉隆坡国际学校。始终把两个孩子和指定实体校区一起考虑。区分首年现金、押金分摊、未来升年级和未定费用，指出支持课程、税、退款、学位及通勤缺口。联系学校、提交表单、分享文件或付款前，先问我们。

phases.title: 收集六所学校官方、带年份的收费和入学资料
phases.note: 逐校整理收费、入学步骤、兄弟姐妹规定和中文课程
phases.judgment: 它没有把 Fairview 的收费页当作最新数据：年费部分仍标着 2023/24 学年。Taylor’s 的收费是 2027 日历年，不是 2027 年 8 月到 2028 年 7 月的学年，并已如实标明。

phases.title: 建立费用模型，写出指南，每条结论都对应来源
phases.judgment: 推荐的是 Sayfol，但它的每年 96,879.20 令吉标注为“另加未确定费用”，不是全包报价。Sri Bestari 只作为有条件的 9 月备选，因为它超出首年预算。

phases.title: 重新核算数字，对照来源检查结论，并测试电脑和手机版面
phases.judgment: 另一轮重新核算通过了 122 项检查。尚未解决的问题都写了出来，没有隐藏：两个孩子的学位未确认、缺少 2027/28 学年账单，部分网页是通过无法证明处于干净状态的浏览器读取的。

workers: 读取 Sri Bestari International 和 Hibiscus 的收费表、入学步骤和中文课程
读取 Taylor’s 和 Fairview 的收费、校历和入学规定，并核对每项收费对应哪一年
读取 HELP 和 Sri KDU 的 2026/27 收费、兄弟姐妹优先权、入学评估和中文选项
